# American Nurses Association (ANA)

> The American Nurses Association advances the nursing profession through credentialing, advocacy, practice standards, and professional development for nurses worldwide.

nursingworld.org is the official digital hub for the American Nurses Association and its enterprise divisions, including the American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC) and American Nurses Foundation. The site serves as a central resource for nursing professionals seeking certification, continuing education, advocacy support, and industry updates.

## Key Topics

- American Nurses Association (ANA)
- American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC)
- American Nurses Foundation
- Nurse Certification
- Professional Credentialing
- Magnet Accreditation
- Healthcare Advocacy
- Nursing Practice Standards
- Continuing Education
- Professional Development
- Workplace Violence Prevention
- Nursing Innovation
- Career Development
- Nurse Wellbeing
- Organizational Excellence

## Core Organizations

- [American Nurses Enterprise](https://www.nursingworld.org): Homepage for American Nurses Enterprise advancing nursing and healthcare
- [American Nurses Association (ANA)](https://www.nursingworld.org/ana): ANA mission and membership overview for nursing professionals
- [American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC)](https://www.nursingworld.org/ancc): ANCC nursing credentialing and certification programs overview
- [American Nurses Foundation](https://www.nursingworld.org/foundation): American Nurses Foundation grants, research, and donation programs

## Practice, Standards & Advocacy

- [Practice and Advocacy - Nursing Empowerment](https://www.nursingworld.org/practice-policy): ANA practice standards, advocacy, and nursing empowerment initiatives
- [Legislative and Political Advocacy for Nurses](https://www.nursingworld.org/practice-policy/advocacy): Legislative advocacy and political engagement resources for nurses
- [Workplace Violence Prevention](https://www.nursingworld.org/practice-policy/work-environment/wpv): Workplace violence prevention and nurse safety resources and pledges

## Professional Development & Education

- [Content Hub](https://www.nursingworld.org/content-hub): Educational content on nursing careers, licensure, and professional development
- [ANA Enterprise Innovation in Nursing](https://www.nursingworld.org/practice-policy/innovation): ANA nursing innovation programs, awards, and professional development

## News & Updates

- [News, Information and Updates for Nurses](https://www.nursingworld.org/news/news-releases): ANA news releases and nursing updates from across the enterprise
